symptom: `diff-local --ref HEAD~1..HEAD` headed a microflow `--- Microflow.<uuid> (current)` / `+++ … (script)`, rendered it as `microflow .ACT_NoteFieldRun` (module dropped), and a page whose container gained `Visible` reported "Summary: 0 new, 1 modified, 0 deleted" with no hunk
cause: Three faults in diff-local's own BSON renderer. The module was looked up from a `$Container` key, but an MPR v2 .mxunit does not hold its container — the .mpr's Unit table does — so it never hit; ObjectName was set to the file UUID regardless; the side labels were the script diff's, hard-coded in the output functions. Pages and snippets rendered a fixed `-- (page widgets)` body, so any widget change rendered identically on both sides
file: `mdl/executor/cmd_diff_local.go` (unitQualifiedName, pageBsonToMDL/snippetBsonToMDL via the describe widget renderer), `cmd_diff.go` (DiffResult.FromLabel/ToLabel), `cmd_diff_output.go`, `hierarchy.go` (ContainerOf), `cmd_pages_describe.go` (raw-data variants of the widget extractors)
insight: **"N modified" with no hunk means the renderer is lossy for that doctype, not that the diff is wrong** — the same shape as the attribute `Type`/`NewType` fix: whatever the renderer does not print, `Current == Proposed` silently swallows. Grep diff-local's renderers for fixed placeholder bodies (`-- (… body)`); nanoflows and layouts still have one. **A v2 unit's container is never in its document**: resolve it from the project hierarchy keyed on the unit ID (= the .mxunit file name). Cheapest real repro: copy `testdata/pedapp`, `git init`, exec + commit twice, `diff-local --ref HEAD~1..HEAD`; the pre-fix binary reproduces the issue's output byte for byte
